claims.claim: Webb image of MACS J0454.1-0300 reveals hundreds more galaxies than the 2014 Hubble image.
claims.episode_span: Webb's sensitivity to redder light reveals hundreds of additional galaxies in the same field.
claims.source_title: Galaxies in a cosmic house of mirrors
claims.supporting_quote: The new Webb image reveals hundreds of galaxies missing from the earlier image.

claims.claim: Smile mission declared ready for science on 23 September after reaching target orbit on 20 June.
claims.episode_span: The European-Chinese Smile mission was declared ready on 23 September to study how Earth responds to the solar wind of charged particles. The spacecraft launched on 19 May and reached its target orbit on 20 June.
claims.supporting_quote: On 23 September, the European-Chinese Smile mission was declared ready to start revealing how Earth responds to the wind of charged particles from the Sun. This follows a busy in-space commissioning period since the spacecraft launched on 19 May and reached its target orbit for science operations on 20 June.
